text:
They make
the opposite of it.
say: They make the opposite of it.

text:
The engines roar.
Then they don't.
say: Put them on in a plane. The engines roar, and then they don't.

text:
A microphone
listens to the roar.
say: Inside the cup, a microphone listens to the roar.

text:
Upside down.
Every peak becomes a trough.
say: A chip flips that sound upside down. Every peak becomes a trough.

text:
It plays the opposite
into your ear.
say: Then a tiny speaker plays it, right into your ear.

text:
Peak meets trough.
They cancel out.
say: Two waves meet. Peak touches trough. And they cancel each other out. Silence.

text:
An engine drone
A crying baby
sub: Cancelling needs a steady, repeating sound. A baby isn't steady.
say: Luckily, that works beautifully on a droning engine. Unluckily, it does almost nothing against a baby crying.

text:
Pushing a swing
at the wrong moment.
sub: The chip pushes the air at exactly the wrong moment — thousands of times a second.
say: Think of pushing a swing. Push at the wrong moment, and you cancel its motion. The chip is just pushing the air at exactly the wrong moment, a thousand times a second.

text:
Your ears can't hear it.
But they can feel it.
say: That's why the headphones feel like pressure when you switch them on. Your ears can't hear the wave, but they can still feel it.

text:
You just got
a second engine.
say: You just got a second engine, playing the exact opposite.
